description: Create a new Cloud DB for Cache (Redis/Valkey) instance. Requires a config group — create one with ncloud_create_cache_config_group or pick an existing configGroupNo from ncloud_list_cache_config_groups. Use dryRun=true to preview without creating.

backupFileRetentionPeriod.description: Backup retention period in days (1-7, default: 1)

backupTime.description: Backup time in HH:mm format (e.g. '01:15'). Required when isBackup=true and isAutomaticBackup=false

cloudCacheImageProductCode.description: Cache image product code. Default: auto-selected

cloudCacheModeCode.description: Cache mode: SIMPLE (standalone) | CLUSTER. Must match the config group version suffix (-simple / -cluster)

cloudCachePort.description: Cache TCP port. Default: 6379; a custom port must be in 10000-20000

cloudCacheProductCode.description: Cache server spec code. Default: minimum spec

cloudCacheServerNamePrefix.description: Server name prefix (3-15 chars: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen)

cloudCacheServiceName.description: Cache service name (3-15 chars: letters, numbers, Korean, hyphen)

configGroupNo.description: Config group number (from ncloud_list_cache_config_groups or ncloud_create_cache_config_group)

dryRun.description: If true, returns a preview without actually creating the instance

engineVersionCode.description: Cache engine version code. Default: latest

isAutomaticBackup.description: Let the server pick the backup time (default: true). If false, backupTime is required

shardCopyCount.description: Replica count per shard, CLUSTER mode only (0-4, default: 0)

shardCount.description: Master node count, CLUSTER mode only (3-10, default: 3)

subnetNo.description: Private subnet number to create the instance in

name: ncloud_create_cache_instance
